prompt: Call agntux_core_triage_view with no arguments and render the result.
_notes: Drives the inline dismiss flow against the first action card the harness discovers. Component testids: action-card-{id} (rows), dismiss-{id} (per-row dismiss button), dismiss-outcome-{kind} (radio), dismiss-confirm (modal submit). The mutation calls callTool('agntux_core_dismiss', {id, outcome:'noise'}) which writes to the action item file, so this fixture has a side effect on the user's ~/agntux/actions/ unless AGNTUX_ROOT_OVERRIDE points at a fixture root.
